title: DHT22 Sensor on LCD
description: Read temperature and humidity from DHT22 sensor and display on 16x2 LCD.
objectives: Use DHT sensor library to read temperature and humidity
Use LiquidCrystal library to control 16x2 LCD in 4-bit mode
Display sensor data on LCD and Serial Monitor
Add a 10kΩ pull-up resistor between DHT22 DATA and 5V
